name: Kat Salm
story: A 2019 Geospatial Research Institute seminar described Kat Salm’s work across government, industry and research/education in New Zealand. She presented findings from a survey of women in the spatial industry; the seminar notice records her 2018 New Zealand Spatial Excellence Award for Women’s Leadership and a 2019 Asia-Pacific Spatial Excellence Award. The institute’s 2021–22 report later listed her as a board member and Business Development Manager at FrontierSI.

In 2019 the Geospatial Research Institute hosted Dr Kat Salm to present findings from a survey of women in the New Zealand spatial industry; the institute also recorded her 2018 New Zealand Spatial Excellence Award for Women’s Leadership and a 2019 Asia-Pacific Spatial Excellence Award.
LINZ’s 2026 Geospatial Capability Committee material lists Kat Salm in Survey & Spatial NZ Spatial Stream representative; Geospatial Capability Committee..
